raw_graphql_pull_request.body: # What does this PR do ? Makes the initialization of per-expert LoRA adapters (`GroupedExpertLinearAdapter`, `share_expert_adapters=False`) and of the shared side of `SharedOuterGroupedExpertAdapter` independent of the expert-parallel, expert-tensor-parallel and tensor-parallel sizes, by resolving the fan-dependent init methods (`xavier`, `kaiming`) from the full per-expert matrix dims instead of the stacked 3-D tensor or the local shard. This is the grouped-expert follow-up that #5843 left open. Background: `GroupedExpertLinearAdapter` stores its weights as `(num_local_experts, dim, in_features)` and `(num_local_experts, out_features, dim)` and initialised them with `nn.init.xavier_normal_` on the 3-D tensor. torch reads `fan_in = dim * in_features` and `fan_out = num_local_experts * in_features` off that tensor, so every expert's `linear_in` started with std `sqrt(2 / ((dim + E_local) * in_features))` instead of `sqrt(2 / (in_features + dim))`, about `sqrt(dim + E_local)` too small (8.4x at rank 64 with 8 local experts, 11x at rank 128 with 8 local experts), and shrinking further with fewer EP ranks. With `lora_B` zero-initialised, the adapter's effective learning rate scales with `||A||`, so per-expert adapters trained from this init barely move while the dense adapters of the same run train normally. # Changelog - `GroupedExpertLinearAdapter.__init__` passes `fan_in=in_features, fan_out=dim` (linear_in) and `fan_in=dim, fan_out=out_features` (linear_out) to `_get_init_fn`, so xavier resolves to a fixed-std normal and kaiming to a fixed-bound uniform computed from the per-expert matrix; the init no longer depends on `num_local_experts` or on the expert-TP shard. For one unsharded expert matrix the draws are bit-identical to before. - `SharedOuterGroupedExpertAdapter.__init__` passes the same full fans for the init handed to its TP-sharded `ColumnParallelLinear` / `RowParallelLinear` and to `PackedPerExpertLinear` (which already initialised one expert matrix at a time, so only the shared side changes). - Tests (CPU, `tests/unit_tests/peft/test_utils.py`, `test_canonical_lora.py`): per-expert xavier scale for 1/4/8 local experts, independence from the expert-TP shard (ETP 1/2/4), per-expert kaiming bound, the shared-outer init resolved from the full fans, and the `CanonicalLoRA` transform producing per-expert adapters at the per-matrix scale. All fail on `main` and pass with the fix. - `MultiLoRA` init paths are untouched (own geometry, as in #5843). # GitHub Actions CI External contribution; CI trigger needs an NVIDIA developer's approval. # Before your PR is "Ready for review" **Pre checks**: - [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] Did you write any new necessary tests? - [x] Did you add or update any necessary documentation? Docstrings and comments at the two init sites; no user-facing docs change. - [x] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? No # Additional Information - Follow-up to #5843 ("Grouped-expert and multi-LoRA init paths call `_get_init_fn` without fan dims and keep their existing behavior ... left for a follow-up"). # Validation Evidence gathered at ba7da40 on `main` 128530a; the branch was then rebased onto `main` 4aa1196 (2c02e34) and the hooks and CPU tests re-run. Environment: `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.09-py3` (the CI base image; torch 2.14 nv26.09, TE 2.19.0), Megatron-Core at `.main.commit` a98aed55, transformers 5.20.2, 8x H200. - CPU harness (no TE): the 7 new tests fail on `main` and pass with the fix; the rest of `tests/unit_tests/peft` unchanged. - GPU, real TE, `pytest tests/unit_tests/peft tests/unit_tests/models/test_adapter_export.py -m "not pleasefixme"` on 2 GPUs: `main` **571 passed, 15 skipped, 0 failed**; branch **578 passed, 15 skipped, 0 failed** (the 7 new tests). - Init census, Qwen3-30B-A3B (128 routed experts) built with `load_weights=False`, `LoRA(share_expert_adapters=False, dim=32)` on `linear_qkv, linear_proj, linear_fc1, linear_fc2`, std of every adapter's `linear_in` divided by `sqrt(2 / (in_features + dim))`: | family | EP1 (128 local experts), main | EP8 (16 local), main | EP1, branch | EP8, branch | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | dense `linear_qkv` / `linear_proj` | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | | per-expert `linear_fc1` (A: [E, 32, 2048]) | **0.080** | **0.145** | 1.000 | 1.000 | | per-expert `linear_fc2` (A: [E, 32, 768]) | **0.081** | **0.147** | 1.000 | 1.000 | On `main` the expert adapters start 7-12x too small and the scale moves with the EP size; the dense adapters (already fixed by #5843) are the reference. - Training, same seed, Qwen3-30B-A3B PEFT recipe layout (TP4 / EP4 on 4 H200, SQuAD, GBS 32, seq 2048, dim 32 / alpha 64, lr 1e-4, 200 steps, `share_expert_adapters=False`), expert adapters only (`linear_fc1, linear_fc2`): | | main | branch | | --- | --- | --- | | train loss, steps 1-10 | 3.041 | 2.051 | | train loss, steps 151-200 | 0.190 | 0.187 | | validation loss at 25 / 50 / 100 / 150 / 200 | 0.2490 / 0.2085 / 0.1901 / 0.1870 / 0.1849 | 0.2211 / 0.1968 / 0.1871 / 0.1839 / 0.1811 | | expert adapter `linear_in` std at start -> end | 0.0039 -> 0.0041 | 0.0310 -> 0.0310 | The branch is below `main` at every validation point. Same comparison with all four targets (`linear_qkv, linear_proj, linear_fc1, linear_fc2`; the dense adapters are initialized identically in both runs): | | main | branch | | --- | --- | --- | | train loss, steps 1-10 | 2.565 | 1.937 | | train loss, steps 151-200 | 0.190 | 0.187 | | validation loss at 25 / 50 / 100 / 150 / 200 | 0.2274 / 0.2003 / 0.1891 / 0.1863 / 0.1841 | 0.2165 / 0.1978 / 0.1870 / 0.1822 / 0.1795 | | expert adapter `linear_in` std at start -> end | 0.0039 -> 0.0040 | 0.0310 -> 0.0310 | | dense adapter `linear_in` std at start -> end | 0.0310 -> 0.0310 | 0.0310 -> 0.0310 | Again below `main` at every validation point; the per-step curves are deterministic (a repeated `main` run reproduced the first one to 4 digits). SQuAD is an easy target, so both runs converge; the gap is in how fast the expert adapters contribute. - `uvx ruff@0.9.9 check`, `check --select I`, `format --check` on the changed files: clean. DCO sign-off on the commit.

 from unittest.mock import patch
@@ -577,6 +578,43 @@ def mock_get_attrs(module, is_expert=False):
         assert adapted.adapter.linear_in.weight.shape == torch.Size([2, 32, 2048])
         assert adapted.adapter.linear_out.weight.shape == torch.Size([2, 512, 32])
 
+    def test_canonical_lora_grouped_expert_per_expert_adapter_init_scale(self):
+        """Per-expert adapters must be initialised like a (dim, in_features) matrix, not like the stacked 3-D tensor.
+
+        The weights are stored as (num_local_experts, dim, in_features); a fan-dependent init evaluated on that
+        tensor would use fan_in = dim * in_features and fan_out = num_local_experts * in_features, shrinking every
+        expert's linear_in by ~sqrt((dim + num_local_experts) * in_features / (in_features + dim)).
+        """
+        model = GroupedExpertMegatronStyleModel()
+        lora = CanonicalLoRA(target_modules=["linear_fc2"], share_expert_adapters=False, lora_A_init_method="xavier")
+
+        def mock_get_attrs(module, is_expert=False):
+            return AdapterAttributes(
+                input_is_parallel=True,
+                in_features=module.in_features,
+                out_features=module.out_features,
+                disable_tensor_parallel_comm=False,
+                disable_sequence_parallel_comm=True,
+                base_linear_is_parallel=True,
+            )
+
+        with patch(
+            "megatron.bridge.peft.canonical_lora.get_adapter_attributes_from_linear",
+            side_effect=mock_get_attrs,
+        ):
+            transformed_model = lora(model, training=True)
+
+        adapter = transformed_model.language_model.decoder.layers[0].mlp.experts.linear_fc2.adapter
+        assert isinstance(adapter, GroupedExpertLinearAdapter)
+        num_local_experts, dim, in_features = adapter.linear_in.weight.shape
+        expected_std = math.sqrt(2.0 / (in_features + dim))  # xavier-normal of one (dim, in_features) matrix
+        stacked_std = math.sqrt(2.0 / (dim * in_features + num_local_experts * in_features))  # the 3-D-tensor fans
+        assert stacked_std < 0.3 * expected_std  # the two scales are far apart for these shapes
+        for expert in range(num_local_experts):
+            std = adapter.linear_in.weight[expert].float().std().item()
+            assert abs(std - expected_std) < 0.05 * expected_std, (expert, std, expected_std, stacked_std)
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(adapter.linear_out.weight) == 0
+
     def test_canonical_lora_wildcard_matching(self):
         """Test CanonicalLoRA transformation with wildcard patterns."""
         model = NestedModel()

@@ -1590,6 +1590,52 @@ def test_finalize_wrapper_runs_mcore_finalize_then_expert_sync(self):
         mock_finalize.assert_called_once_with(model, None, pg_collection=pg_collection, force_all_reduce=True)
         mock_sync.assert_called_once_with(model, ep_group=pg_collection.ep)

+    def test_shared_outer_adapter_init_uses_full_per_matrix_fans(self, mock_col_linear, mock_row_linear, mock_packed):
+        """The init handed to the TP-sharded shared side and to the per-expert pack must not depend on the shard shape."""
+        in_features, dim, out_features = 1024, 16, 512
+        mock_config = MockModelParallelConfig()
+        mock_config._pg_collection = make_mock_pg_collection(ep_size=2)
+        shared = Mock()
+        shared.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2))
+        per_expert = Mock()
+        per_expert.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2, 2))
+        mock_col_linear.return_value = shared
+        mock_packed.return_value = per_expert
+
+        with (
+            patch("torch.distributed.is_available", return_value=True),
+            patch("torch.distributed.is_initialized", return_value=True),
+            patch("torch.distributed.get_global_rank", return_value=7),
+            patch("torch.distributed.broadcast"),
+            patch.object(torch.Tensor, "is_cuda", new_callable=PropertyMock, return_value=True),
+        ):
+            SharedOuterGroupedExpertAdapter(
+                in_features=in_features,
+                out_features=out_features,
+                dim=dim,
+                num_local_experts=2,

+                input_is_parallel=False,
+                model_parallel_config=mock_config,
+            )
+
+        column_init = mock_col_linear.call_args.kwargs["init_method"]
+        row_init = mock_packed.call_args.kwargs["init_method"]
+        # The tensor-derived xavier reads its fan off whatever shard Megatron hands it; the resolved init does not.
+        assert column_init is not nn.init.xavier_normal_
+        expected_std = math.sqrt(2.0 / (in_features + dim))

@@ -1637,6 +1683,74 @@ def test_shared_outer_adapter_marks_only_the_shared_side(self, mock_col_linear,
 class TestGroupedExpertLinearAdapter:
     """Tests for grouped-expert per-expert LoRA adapters."""
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("num_local_experts", [1, 4, 8])
+    def test_grouped_expert_linear_adapter_xavier_init_is_per_expert_scale(self, num_local_experts):
+        """Each expert's linear_in must start like one (dim, in_features) xavier matrix, whatever the local expert count."""
+        in_features, dim, out_features = 1024, 16, 512
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        adapter = GroupedExpertLinearAdapter(
+            in_features=in_features,
+            out_features=out_features,
+            dim=dim,
+            num_local_experts=num_local_experts,
+            base_linear_name="decoder.layers.0.mlp.experts.linear_fc2",
+            activation="identity",
+            input_is_parallel=True,
+            model_parallel_config=MockModelParallelConfig(),
+        )
+        expected_std = math.sqrt(2.0 / (in_features + dim))
+        # The fan torch reads off the stacked (experts, dim, in_features) tensor would give this, far smaller.
+        stacked_std = math.sqrt(2.0 / (dim * in_features + num_local_experts * in_features))
+        assert stacked_std < 0.3 * expected_std
+        for expert in range(num_local_experts):
+            std = adapter.linear_in.weight[expert].float().std().item()
+            assert std == pytest.approx(expected_std, rel=0.05), (expert, std, expected_std, stacked_std)
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(adapter.linear_out.weight) == 0
+
+    def test_grouped_expert_linear_adapter_init_is_independent_of_expert_tensor_parallel_shard(self):
+        """An expert-TP shard of linear_in must draw from the same distribution as the unsharded weight."""
+        in_features, dim, out_features = 1024, 16, 512
+        stds = {}
+        for etp in (1, 2, 4):
+            cfg = MockModelParallelConfig()
+            cfg.expert_tensor_parallel_size = etp
+            torch.manual_seed(0)
+            adapter = GroupedExpertLinearAdapter(
+                in_features=in_features,
+                out_features=out_features,
+                dim=dim,
+                num_local_experts=2,
+                base_linear_name="decoder.layers.0.mlp.experts.linear_fc2",
+                activation="identity",
+                input_is_parallel=True,
+                model_parallel_config=cfg,
+            )
+            assert adapter.linear_in.weight.shape == (2, dim, in_features // etp)
+            stds[etp] = adapter.linear_in.weight.float().std().item()
+        expected_std = math.sqrt(2.0 / (in_features + dim))
+        for etp, std in stds.items():
+            assert std == pytest.approx(expected_std, rel=0.05), (etp, std, expected_std)
+
+    def test_grouped_expert_linear_adapter_kaiming_init_is_per_expert_scale(self):
+        """kaiming on the stacked tensor would use fan_in = dim * in_features; the per-expert bound is 1/sqrt(in_features)."""
+        in_features, dim, out_features = 1024, 16, 512
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        adapter = GroupedExpertLinearAdapter(
+            in_features=in_features,
+            out_features=out_features,
+            dim=dim,
+            num_local_experts=4,
+            base_linear_name="decoder.layers.0.mlp.experts.linear_fc2",
+            activation="identity",
+            column_init_method="kaiming",
+            input_is_parallel=True,
+            model_parallel_config=MockModelParallelConfig(),
+        )
+        bound = 1.0 / math.sqrt(in_features)
+        weight = adapter.linear_in.weight.float()
+        assert weight.abs().max().item() <= bound
+        assert weight.std().item() == pytest.approx(bound / math.sqrt(3.0), rel=0.05)
